title: Nvidia lost $440 billion in a morning. How much is that?

scenes.say: Okay? What just happened? Nvidia just lost four hundred and forty billion dollars before lunch. But in my day, a billion was a lot of money!
So how much is that? Split it between every American, and you'd each get about thirteen hundred dollars. I'd buy a new kettle.
It's also more than twice what Nvidia earned in a whole year. So it's gone in one morning! I lose my glasses slower than that.
Why? Because the boss quit. When one person is the whole story, investors panic. You see, it's like the chippy losing its best chef.
